Subject: Rollout schedule, escrow & doc custodians

Team —

Attached is the latest rollout matrix (rollout_matrix_v0.3.xlsx). Key things I need us to confirm by EOD:

- Custodians: who owns each doc section (API, console UX, billing, runbooks)
- Escrow window: proposed 2026-06-12 to 2026-06-14 (read-only) — OK for legal/procurement?
- Canary plan: short canary on 2026-06-10 with 10% traffic slice; who will own the canary rollback run?

Notes: AcmeCorp (Peter) is expecting a firm go/no-go by 06/08 so they can schedule their integration testing. We also have a partner onboarding (EdgeOps) that needs the ops runbook finalized.

Please reply with ownership and any redlines to the dates.

Thanks,
Marissa
